title: Install State Manifest
description: Records every file written during plugin generation or installation, enabling drift detection

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of generation (excluded from determinism hash)

templateVersion.description: Semver of the template used for generation

profileHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the profile content at generation time

source.description: Relative path to the source template file

dest.description: Relative path to the output file within the plugin or target project

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the generated content
